title: The Book of Genesis, Part 1: Creation to Babel | Full Story (KJV)
description:
The first eleven chapters of the Book of Genesis, from creation to the Tower of Babel, read from the King James Version, in one sitting of about 37 minutes.

What is in it: the Keeper's reading of Genesis 1 over still paintings; our Shorts on Eden, the serpent, the exile, Cain and Abel, Enoch, Noah and the flood (vertical videos, framed for widescreen); and our two widescreen story films, The Flood Ends and The Tower of Babel. New in this video: more than 8 minutes of the Keeper's own commentary between the stories (the oldest promise in Genesis 3:15, Abel's blood, the mark of Cain, other ancient flood stories, the human heart before and after the flood, and how Genesis is built).

first_comment: In these eleven chapters people hid from God, ran from God, and built toward heaven without him. Which of the three do you recognize in yourself? The stories are read from the King James Version; the Keeper's notes between them are the channel's own.
